summary: Phase 0 establishes the executable posture only. No Harbor trial, smoke task, case adapter, grader, or comparison runner was run or built.

installer.checksum_source: version manifest, verified by the installer before install

npm_package.name: @anthropic-ai/claude-code
npm_package.note: recorded for traceability; the image uses the native installer, matching Harbor's own install path

harbor_adapter.detection: compares claude --version to the requested version and skips install when it matches
harbor_adapter.trajectory: JSONL sessions under logs_dir/sessions/projects; invocation/model/usage fields evaluated in a later phase

agent.largest_layer: 273 MB (Claude Code native binary; downloads cleaned after install)
agent.contains: python3, bash, curl, procps, Claude Code 2.1.218; no D7Y source, evals, graders, settings, or credentials

verifier.contains: python3, bash; no D7Y source, graders, settings, or credentials

reproducibility.claude_pin: version 2.1.218 + bootstrap sha256 + manifest-verified binary checksum
reproducibility.final_build_from_pre_build_commit: rebuilt both images from commit a48dd0e; digests identical to the initial from-scratch build (agent 5bd6dca2…, verifier ae7a327a…)

canary_scan.agent_image: clean (no forbidden files, content, or secret env)
canary_scan.synthetic_secret_canary: clean (secret supplied as build-arg and context file did not leak into the image)
canary_scan.agent_dot_claude_dir: /home/agent/.claude exists as a Claude Code installer artifact; inspected to contain only default config backups (16 KiB; generated machineID/userID, migration flags); no settings.json, no credentials
canary_scan.limitation: A filesystem scan proves the searched-for forbidden material and named secret bytes are absent; it cannot exhaustively disprove unknown secret bytes without reading every byte of the image.

storage_enforcement.basis: local Docker overlay2 on an ext4 data root with no XFS/project-quota support; Harbor passes storage_mb through only on quota-capable providers. Recorded as a limitation, not a blocker.

limitations: No XFS/project-quota data root; Harbor-managed writable-layer storage is unsupported (declared value retained as task metadata only).
No host firewall certifies the launcher bootstrap declaration; not a Phase 0 blocker.
Independent upstream route attestation is unavailable; effective model/provider remain runtime evidence, recorded when the endpoint exposes them and otherwise unavailable.
The image scan cannot exhaustively disprove unknown secret bytes without reading every byte.
evidence_store: No eval-evidence directory is created for Phase 0; no Harbor trial ran and no raw run artifacts exist to retain. Run evidence directories begin with Phase 1.

inputs_for_phase_1.notes: Phase 1 builds the Harbor Oracle smoke task consuming this profile, envelope, and these images; it stages the runtime payload and adds the verifier test script and public checker to the separate verifier tests/ directory.

verification.image_build: both images built; digests stable across initial and final (from-commit) builds (pass)
verification.image_inspection: non-root users, no volumes/mounts, clean env key names, digest-pinned base (pass)
verification.dockerfile_inspection: no COPY/ADD/secret mounts; build args pinned (pass)
verification.canary_scan: agent and verifier clean; synthetic secret did not leak (pass)
